Through: Ms.Rupali Bandopadh  State with Mr.Aksha  Mr.Abhijeet Kumar, 
 SI Sahan Singh, PS   Ms.Aakriti Dawar, A  with R2 in person.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA  ORDER % 20.04.2023 5.
This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.609/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Mehrauli, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
6. The marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnized on 08.12.2013 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
However, due to marital discord both the husband and wife started residing separately since December, 2019.

At the instance of respondent no.2 the present FIR was registered on 28.10.2021.
7.

Due to intervention of family members and friends, a settlement has been arrived at between the parties and in lieu of said settlement the petitioner no.1 agreed to pay an amount of Rs.15.00 lacs to the respondent no.2 towards all her claims including maintenance (present, past and future),
permanent alimony, stridhan etc.
It is submitted an amount of Rs.10.00 lacs has already been paid and the balance of Rs.5.00 lacs has been paid today through demand draft dated 05.04.2023 bearing no.056928 drawn on by HDFC Bank.

8. The respondent no.2 is present in the Court and has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and she has no objection in case the FIR is quashed as the matter is settled between the Rajat Vardhan & Ors vs State & Anr on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127054460/
1 parties and she has no claim left of whatsoever nature against the petitioners herein.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The affidavits of parties are on record.
The learned ASC for the State also has no objection in case the petition is allowed.
9. In view of the above there is no impediment in quashing the present FIR as the matter is settled between the parties and it would never entail in conviction of the petitioners herein.
Consequently, the FIR No.609/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Mehrauli, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom stands quashed.
Pending application(s), also stands disposed of.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
